verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a support and customer-work platform like Pylon, but the evidence pack never documents selecting many issues, accounts, or tasks and acting on them at once. The available evidence (a general API, per-event triggers, an MCP server that can update issues, single-issue agent assignment) consists of developer building blocks or adjacent automation, not a bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
